## [1.3.8](https://github.com/ZoomSass/Mighty-Morphing/compare/v1.3.7...v1.3.8) (2026-11-13)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* Modern UI note now says v1.3.7. ([14708cb](https://github.com/ZoomSass/Mighty-Morphing/commit/14708cb3a7f6e055b43fc59eeb3a666dc2a0fec6))

patches.name: Backup and restore
patches.description: [v1.3: Morphe settings covers splash, theme, comments, and show and hide] Save Joey settings to a file and restore them later. Log in to the same Reddit account before restoring subscriptions. Access via Joey Settings - Morphe Settings.

patches.name: Disable tooltips
patches.description: Turns off the first-run tips Joey shows.

patches.name: Dismiss without tearing
patches.description: Swiping a photo away to close it looks smooth instead of tearing.

patches.name: Editor image and GIF upload
patches.description: Uploads images and GIFs to Reddit directly when adding comments. Both can be uploaded via the image button. Also adds keyboard gif auto upload to reddit (click markdown in editor (far left icon) to enable keyboard gif support).

patches.name: Fix collapsed replies
patches.description: Loads replies that stay hidden when Reddit will not open them. Based on the Patcheddit fix.

patches.name: Fix login page
patches.description: Makes Reddit's login page load and work properly inside Joey, and clears the cookie banner out of the way.

patches.name: Inline comment media
patches.description: [v1.3: Scroll up or down on comment images, GIFs, and videos] Shows GIFs, pictures, subreddit emojis and reddit videos inline in the comments instead of as links. Tap to open. Drag left or right to resize, as usual. YouTube links use a 16:9 preview with the title. Extra settings to tweak in Joey Settings - Morphe Settings.

patches.name: Log in with your own client ID
patches.description: Lets Joey log in with another app's client ID, for when Joey's own login stops working. Normal option here is to sign in to RedReader once, then paste the App ID from Reddit's "you authorized an app" email into this patch's settings in expert mode.

options.description: The App ID from Reddit's "you authorized an app" email. Leave empty to keep Joey's own login.
Has to match the app the ID came from. The default works for RedReader.
Sent with Reddit requests. The default is RedReader's.

patches.name: Modern UI
patches.description: [v1.3.7: AMOLED black now appears in settings. v1.3.6: Classic Joey can be turned back on. The Joey bird image in sidebar can be toggled on when using ModernUI. Performance improvements for Modern UI. Post style settings are back, without post layout, thumbnail side, or corner roundness. Thumbnail post style ui fixes.] With ModernUI layout turned on (on by default) Joey's own themes and colour changes are turned off. ModernUI layout patch includes Aqua (default), Blue, Purple, Coral, Mint, Gold, Amber, Black, Sky, and AMOLED black themes and can be set in Joey Settings - Morphe Settings. Posts use one compact list, so card and compact are no longer separate. Various customisable UI options are in Morphe Settings. The media viewer has its first UI tweaks in this release, including bigger icons and a full screen view.

patches.name: Open Reddit share links
patches.description: Opens modern Reddit share links directly to the right post or comment in Joey instead of loading the web page. To open Reddit links from other apps, make sure all links are ticked in Android Settings -> Apps -> Joey -> Open by default.

patches.name: RedGifs with sound
patches.description: RedGifs clips play with their sound, in HD when it's available.

patches.name: Search auto open keyboard
patches.description: Opens the keyboard automatically for homepage search and comment search. The Enter and Search keys start the search.

patches.name: Show/Hide
patches.description: [v1.3: Drag the handle to reorder] Choose which comment editor buttons, sidebar entries, subreddit toolbar items, and post actions are shown. What does not fit on a post goes in its menu. Adjust viewable options in Joey Settings - Morphe Settings.

patches.name: Skip ads and checks
patches.description: Removes ads everywhere and also drops the Play Store install check and crash reporting.

patches.name: Splash Screen
patches.description: [v1.3.5: Animation can be turned off] Logo inspired by u/otheast. Animation and colours are fully customisable in Joey Settings - Morphe Settings.

patches.name: Subreddit filter options
patches.description: Adds a subreddit suffix filter and lets you toggle subreddit filters on or off without deleting them. Configure in Joey - Settings - Filters, or from the feed Filter out posts menu.
